errors.text_span: Има общо пет категории в кръговата диаграма
errors.evidence: The description states there are five categories in the pie chart, but visually there are only four slices. The legend contains five categories, but the category "Под 1 година" (Under 1 year) has a value of 0% and is not represented by a slice in the chart itself.
The description identifies the color for the category "Над 1 до 5 години" (Over 1 to 5 years) as orange (оранжево), but both the legend and the corresponding slice are red.
The description identifies the color for the category "От 6 до 15 години" (From 6 to 15 years) as yellow (жълто), but both the legend and the corresponding slice are orange.

errors.text_span: а категориите са подредени според процентните си стойности
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that the categories (slices) are arranged according to their percentage values. The slices are arranged in the following order of value: 31.8%, 13.6%, 36.4%, 18.2%, which is not an ascending or descending sequence.
